agent.problem: Too many choices require luck rather than a reasoned pick. Cards 4, 9, 10, 12, 17 and 18 ask for facts that cannot be reasoned out or eliminated from the earlier cards: the direction east, the exact cave, the field-and-Sarah statement, Beer-lahai-roi, the Havilah-to-Shur span and hostility toward the brothers. That is more than a few discovery questions, leaving much of the stop a guessing game.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
